requirements.name: Backend engineering experience
requirements.source: - 2+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend services, or equivalent experience from substantial projects.

requirements.name: Relational database / SQL
requirements.source: - Experience designing relational database schemas and writing efficient SQL (PostgreSQL preferred).

requirements.name: REST or gRPC APIs
requirements.source: - Experience building and maintaining REST or gRPC APIs.

requirements.name: Distributed systems concepts
requirements.source: - Familiarity with distributed systems concepts: consistency, retries, idempotency, queues.

requirements.name: Docker and CI/CD
requirements.source: - Experience with Docker and a CI/CD system.

requirements.name: Testing and code review
requirements.source: - A habit of writing tests and reviewing code carefully.

requirements.name: Design backend services
requirements.source: - Design, build and operate backend services in Python and Go, with PostgreSQL as our main datastore.

requirements.name: API evolution
requirements.source: - Evolve our public REST API and internal gRPC interfaces, including versioning, authentication and rate limiting.

requirements.name: Database schema and migrations
requirements.source: - Design database schemas and migrations that keep financial data correct under concurrent writes.

requirements.name: Job scheduler and event pipeline
requirements.source: - Improve the reliability of our job scheduler and event pipeline (Kafka), including idempotency and retries.

requirements.name: CI/CD improvement
requirements.source: - Improve our CI/CD pipelines, test suites and deployment tooling.

requirements.name: On-call and incident response
requirements.source: - Participate in the on-call rotation for the services the team owns, and lead the follow-up after incidents.

requirements.name: Secure coding
requirements.source: - Work with our security engineer on secure coding practices, secrets handling and access control in our services.

requirements.name: Kafka or event streaming
requirements.source: - Experience with Kafka or another event streaming platform.

requirements.name: Financial systems
requirements.source: - Experience with payments, accounting or other financial systems.

requirements.name: Kubernetes or AWS
requirements.source: - Experience running services on Kubernetes or AWS.
